name: SEO Ready
author: Mahdi

sections.description:
SEO Ready gives WordPress site owners a lightweight way to manage essential SEO settings directly inside the block editor. Instead of adding a heavy SEO suite with dozens of unused features, SEO Ready focuses on the content-level controls many websites need most: custom SEO titles, meta descriptions, canonical URLs, search visibility settings, schema markup, social sharing data, breadcrumbs, and FAQ content.

The plugin is designed for privacy, speed, and accessibility. It helps improve how your pages and posts appear in search engines and on social platforms while keeping the editing experience simple for beginners, creators, bloggers, marketers, and developers.

Essential SEO Controls

SEO Ready adds a dedicated SEO sidebar to the WordPress editor, making it easy to optimize each page or post individually.

You can manage:

  • SEO Title: Add a custom title for search engines.
  • Meta Description: Write a focused description for search results.
  • Meta Keywords: Add relevant keywords for content organization.
  • Canonical URL: Help search engines understand the preferred version of a page.
  • Redirect URL: Send visitors to another URL using a meta refresh redirect.
  • Redirect Delay: Control the delay before the redirect happens.
  • Noindex Control: Prevent selected content from appearing in search results.
  • Nofollow Control: Ask search engines not to follow links on selected content.

Schema Markup

SEO Ready helps search engines better understand your content by letting you choose the most relevant schema type for each page.

Supported schema options include:

  • Web Page
  • Item Page
  • About Page
  • FAQ Page
  • QA Page
  • Profile Page
  • Contact Page
  • Collection Page
  • Checkout Page
  • Search Results Page

For article-based content, SEO Ready also supports article schema options such as Article, Blog Posting, News Article, Satirical Article, Tech Article, and Report.

Social Media Sharing

SEO Ready gives you control over how content appears when shared on social platforms.

For Facebook and Twitter/X, you can customize:

  • Social sharing image
  • Social sharing title
  • Social sharing description

This helps you create more engaging previews and maintain better control over how your content looks outside your website.

Breadcrumbs Block

SEO Ready includes a block editor Breadcrumbs block that helps visitors understand where they are on your website.

The Breadcrumbs block can improve navigation and provide helpful page hierarchy context. It includes customization options for the delimiter, site title display, current page title, site title override, colors, spacing, typography, and alignment.

FAQ Block

SEO Ready includes a simple FAQ block for creating frequently asked question sections inside the WordPress editor.

The FAQ block uses native WordPress details blocks for question-and-answer content and lets you add a custom heading with selectable heading tags. This makes it useful for landing pages, documentation pages, product pages, service pages, and support content.

Built for the Block Editor

SEO Ready is designed to work naturally inside the WordPress block editor. SEO settings, schema options, social sharing controls, breadcrumbs, and FAQ content are all managed from the editing experience you already use.

Why Choose SEO Ready?

SEO Ready is a good fit if you want a lightweight SEO plugin that focuses on practical, content-level optimization without unnecessary bloat.

Use SEO Ready to:

  • Improve search result titles and descriptions.
  • Add page-level schema markup.
  • Control how pages appear on social media.
  • Add breadcrumbs for better navigation.
  • Build FAQ sections directly in the editor.
  • Manage noindex and nofollow settings per page.
  • Keep your SEO workflow simple and focused.
sections.installation:
Minimum Requirements

  • PHP version 7.4 or greater.
  • MySQL version 5.6 or greater, or MariaDB version 10.0 or greater.
  • WordPress version 5.9 or greater.

Automatic Installation

Automatic installation is the easiest option. WordPress handles the file transfer, and you do not need to leave your browser.

To install SEO Ready automatically:

  1. Log in to your WordPress dashboard.
  2. Go to Plugins > Add New.
  3. Search for “SEO Ready”.
  4. Click “Install Now”.
  5. Activate the plugin.

Manual Installation

To install SEO Ready manually:

  1. Download the plugin ZIP file.
  2. Go to Plugins > Add New in your WordPress dashboard.
  3. Click “Upload Plugin”.
  4. Choose the ZIP file and click “Install Now”.
  5. Activate the plugin.

You can also upload the plugin folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory using FTP, then activate it from the Plugins screen.

Updating

Automatic updates should work smoothly. Before updating any WordPress plugin, it is always recommended to back up your website.
sections.faq:
What is SEO Ready?

SEO Ready is a lightweight WordPress SEO plugin that helps you manage essential SEO settings for pages and posts, including SEO titles, meta descriptions, canonical URLs, schema markup, social sharing data, breadcrumbs, and FAQ content.

Do I need to be an SEO expert to use SEO Ready?

No. SEO Ready is designed to be simple and editor-friendly. You can manage important SEO settings directly from the WordPress editor without advanced technical knowledge.

Can I customize SEO settings for each page or post?

Yes. SEO Ready lets you customize SEO titles, meta descriptions, keywords, canonical URLs, redirects, search visibility, link follow behavior, schema, and social sharing data on individual pages and posts.

Does SEO Ready support schema markup?

Yes. SEO Ready includes schema type controls for pages and posts, including Web Page, FAQ Page, Contact Page, Collection Page, Search Results Page, and more.

Can I control how my content appears on Facebook and Twitter/X?

Yes. SEO Ready lets you set custom social sharing images, titles, and descriptions for Facebook and Twitter/X.

Does SEO Ready include breadcrumbs?

Yes. SEO Ready includes a Breadcrumbs block for the WordPress block editor. You can add it to supported pages and customize its delimiter, site title display, current page title, spacing, colors, typography, and alignment.

Does SEO Ready include an FAQ block?

Yes. SEO Ready includes an FAQ block that helps you create structured question-and-answer sections using the WordPress block editor.

Can I prevent a page from being indexed by search engines?

Yes. SEO Ready includes a noindex control that allows you to prevent selected pages or posts from appearing in search results.

Can I use SEO Ready with any WordPress theme?

SEO Ready is designed to work with most modern WordPress themes, especially themes built for the block editor.

Is SEO Ready lightweight?

Yes. SEO Ready focuses on essential SEO features and avoids unnecessary bloat, making it a practical option for users who want simple SEO controls without a large plugin footprint.
